worked_solution:
The tangential component of acceleration is given by

$$
{a}_{T}=\frac{v\cdot a}{||v||}.
$$

First, we compute the velocity vector by differentiating the position vector and evaluating it at $t=0,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}v & =⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}({e}^{t}),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(-t{e}^{t}),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(2t)⟩ \\  & =⟨{e}^{t},\,-(t+1){e}^{t},\,2⟩, \\ v(0) & =⟨{e}^{0},\,-(0+1){e}^{0},\,2⟩ \\  & =⟨1,\,-1,\,2⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we compute the acceleration vector by differentiating the velocity vector and it evaluating at $t=0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}a & =⟨\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}({e}^{t}),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(-(t+1){e}^{t}),\,\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(2)⟩ \\  & =⟨{e}^{t},\,-(t+2){e}^{t},\,0⟩, \\ a(0) & =⟨{e}^{0},\,-(0+2){e}^{0},\,0⟩ \\  & =⟨1,\,-2,\,0⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Then, we compute $v(0)\cdot a(0)$ and $||v(0)||:$

$$
\begin{aligned}v(0)\cdot a(0) & =⟨1,\,-1,\,2⟩\cdot ⟨1,\,-2,\,0⟩ \\  & =3, \\ ||v(0)|| & =\sqrt{(1)^{2}+(-1)^{2}+(2)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{6}\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we calculate the tangential component of the acceleration at $t=0,$ and we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{a}_{T} & =\frac{v(0)\cdot a(0)}{||v(0)||} \\  & =\frac{3}{\sqrt{6}} \\  & =\frac{\sqrt{6}}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the tangential component of the acceleration is $\frac{\sqrt{6}}{2}\,{\text{ms}}^{-2}.$
html:
The tangential component of acceleration is given by aT=v⋅a||v||.

First, we compute the velocity vector by differentiating the position vector and evaluating it at t=0, as follows: v=⟨ddt(et),ddt(−tet),ddt(2t)⟩=⟨et,−(t+1)et,2⟩,v(0)=⟨e0,−(0+1)e0,2⟩=⟨1,−1,2⟩

Next, we compute the acceleration vector by differentiating the velocity vector and it evaluating at t=0: a=⟨ddt(et),ddt(−(t+1)et),ddt(2)⟩=⟨et,−(t+2)et,0⟩,a(0)=⟨e0,−(0+2)e0,0⟩=⟨1,−2,0⟩

Then, we compute v(0)⋅a(0) and ||v(0)||:

v(0)⋅a(0)=⟨1,−1,2⟩⋅⟨1,−2,0⟩=3,||v(0)||=(1)2+(−1)2+(2)2=6

Finally, we calculate the tangential component of the acceleration at t=0, and we get aT=v(0)⋅a(0)||v(0)||=36=62.

Therefore, the tangential component of the acceleration is 62ms−2.
